description.en: Sign in with Google through Firebase Authentication, for sites whose users already have accounts in a Firebase project. New sign-ins register as guests; a member whose email was already verified on this site signs in to that account.
description.zh-Hant: 透過 Firebase Authentication 用 Google 登入，適合使用者已經在 Firebase 專案裡的網站。第一次登入會註冊為訪客；已經是會員、而且 Email 在這個網站驗證過的，直接登入那個帳號。

description.en: apiKey from the Firebase console: Project settings → General → Your apps.
description.zh-Hant: Firebase 主控台「專案設定 → 一般 → 你的應用程式」裡的 apiKey。

description.en: authDomain from the same place, e.g. my-app.firebaseapp.com. Add this site's domain under Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains.
description.zh-Hant: 同一個地方的 authDomain，例如 my-app.firebaseapp.com。另外要在 Authentication →「設定 → 已授權網域」加上這個網站的網域。

description.en: projectId from the same place. Google must be turned on under Authentication → Sign-in method.
description.zh-Hant: 同一個地方的 projectId。Authentication →「登入方式」要開啟 Google。
